summary.statement: D2 was met in 0 of 2 registered family readings and in 0 of 1 non-registered readings (3 D2 looks in total); one AGG_POSITIVE comparison passes a true null in about 0.07-2% of replicates under six moderate NRM1 known laws and about 8% when one version or split dominates (NRM1 RULES.md 5.5); a D2 look is an intersection-union conjunction of four such comparisons (TWIN, SBC, SPEND, RO), so its false-pass rate is at most that of its weakest member; with K D2 looks the chance that at least one passes by chance is at most K times the per-look rate.
